lines: - **Setting up a counting screen**, enabling symbologies, customizing brushes, translating hints, adding status overlays, or managing the camera lifecycle → read [references/integration.md](references/integration.md).

- **Changing view controls on an existing screen**, including hiding the exit button or toolbar, changing toolbar labels, or configuring toolbar accessibility → read [references/toolbar.md](references/toolbar.md).

- **Scanning against an expected list**, picklist, or packing slip → read [references/capture-list.md](references/capture-list.md). For an empty screen, also read [references/integration.md](references/integration.md) for setup.
For visibility toggles and the exit, shutter, list and toolbar buttons, see [View controls and toolbar](toolbar.md).
For the toolbar settings example and button labels and accessibility strings, see [View controls and toolbar](toolbar.md).
For expected quantities, completion callbacks, and the correct, wrong and missing barcodes in a session, see [Scanning against a capture list](capture-list.md).
# MatrixScan Count view controls and toolbar in React Native
For an existing `BarcodeCountView`, keep its mode, camera lifecycle and listeners. Apply the visibility properties in the existing view ref callback.
For a new React Native screen, follow the [integration setup](integration.md) for packages, permissions and camera lifecycle.
